description: This file defines the WakeCheckFilter class, a frame processor for detecting wake phrases in transcription frames within the Pipecat project. It filters frames based on wake word detection, maintains participant states, and includes keepalive functionality.

classes.name: WakeCheckFilter
classes.description: A frame processor that filters transcription frames based on wake phrase detection, maintaining participant states and a keepalive timeout.

classes.name: WakeCheckFilter.WakeState
classes.description: Enumeration of wake detection states: IDLE and AWAKE.

classes.name: WakeCheckFilter.ParticipantState
classes.description: Tracks the wake detection state, timer, and accumulator for individual participants.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WakeCheckFilter with specified wake phrases and keepalive timeout.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, filtering based on wake phrase detection and maintaining participant states.
